Messages.Author: Karl Innes
Messages.Body:
Recently came up in a game and for the life of me I couldn't
remember the ruling. When relocating existing equipment/retainers, can
you only move them one at a time or can you move more than one in the
same action?? (provided the target HAS two or more to give)

Thanks, Karl

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


You cannot transfer retainers at all (barring explicit card text,
of course).

When transfering equipment (as in the 'transfer equipment' cardless
action), you may transfer any number of equipment cards from one minion
you control to the acting minion.
